prototype/title.sentence: prototype/title: threshold 0.05 is chosen in 12 of 12 leave-one-window-out folds; held-out mean all-tab F1 over the four shares 0.676 (in-sample best 0.05, 0.676; no threshold 0.608). At 0.05, 18% of loose hidden tabs are attached (each one wrong; 100% with no threshold) and 8% of hidden tabs with a gold task go to a group of another task. Attaching first scores more than 0.03 below a fresh plan at 10% new tabs (gap 0.045); from there a new plan is worth a request.
